label: Click
description: Click on the computer's screen: `args` is `{ x, y, button, count, modifiers }`, all optional. `x` and `y` are pixels of the screen (a screenshot's pixels); left out, the click lands where the mouse is. `button` is left (the default), right, middle, back or forward; `count` is 1 (the default), 2 for a double click or 3 for a triple click; `modifiers` are keys held during the click, joined by + (`ctrl+shift`).

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The click, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `click` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.
